subject.title: Add Junie as a built-in agent (`junie --acp true`)

question: Should acpx reserve `junie` as a permanent built-in name even though that changes the existing raw-command fallback for `acpx junie`?
rationale: The implementation adds a durable user-facing naming convention and changes an existing invocation path; repository policy treats such conventions as compatibility-sensitive product surface, so code review cannot determine the intended contract alone.

options.title: Adopt Junie with compatibility proof
options.body: Approve `junie` as a core built-in after documenting or testing the supported override/migration path and receiving real Junie ACP evidence.

options.title: Keep Junie custom-configured
options.body: Leave Junie to the existing raw-command or agent-override path rather than reserve a new core keyword.

options.title: Use a distinct built-in name
options.body: Choose a less collision-prone stable alias if maintainers want first-class support without changing existing `acpx junie` resolution.

recommendation.title: Adopt Junie with compatibility proof
recommendation.body: Approve `junie` as a core built-in after documenting or testing the supported override/migration path and receiving real Junie ACP evidence.
